purpose: Bounded causal transfer diagnostic for sparse COVTrack cadence: reuse the fixed quality cut and bridge a birth to one prior physical state for at most the registered 30-source-frame gap using a constant box-velocity prediction from the last two persistent observations. This is not formal frontend qualification or training.

source.source_selection: Read only the already completed anonymous physical streams; no frontend inference or duplicate full cache.

development_pseudo.selection_rule: Reuse the previously frozen first eight development_pseudo role IDs; no outcome or GT selection.

policy_train_pseudo.selection_rule: Reuse the previously frozen ten policy_train_pseudo role IDs; no outcome or GT selection.

fixed_mechanism.score_threshold_rationale: Reuse the already registered full-407 counterfactual cut; no new threshold sweep.
fixed_mechanism.reassociation_max_gap_rationale: Reuse the previously preregistered upper bridge bound from the full-Train source-cadence audit; dominant gaps are 30, 25, and 24 source frames.
fixed_mechanism.reassociation_rule: At each observed source frame, one-to-one Hungarian IoU bridge from a current birth to at most one prior persistent state whose last observation is no more than 30 source frames earlier; no future observations.
fixed_mechanism.candidate_order: causal score gate first, then velocity-predicted gap-aware physical reassociation

evaluation.continuity: adjacent sealed geometry-only GT observations with same candidate IDs
